definitions.explanation: The subject line of an email or the title of a document or case. Most commonly encountered in email and business correspondence contexts.

examples.japanese: ⟦メール→メール：04435_meeru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{件名|けんめい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入力|にゅうりょく}して→入力する：28127_nyuuryokusuru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please enter the email subject line.

examples.japanese: {件名|けんめい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日付|ひづけ}→日付：03706_hizuke⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れて→入れる：01098_ireru⟧おいた。
examples.english: I put the meeting date in the subject line.

examples.japanese: {件名|けんめい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{空白|くうはく}→空白：15426_kuuhaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦メール→メール：04435_meeru⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{迷惑|めいわく}→迷惑：02432_meiwaku⟧⟦メール→メール：04435_meeru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{間違|まちが}われる→間違う：03036_machigau⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Emails with a blank subject line are sometimes mistaken for spam.

notes:
Primarily used in the context of email, where it refers to the subject field. Also used in business and administrative contexts for the title or heading of a case or matter. In Japanese business culture, clear and concise subject lines are considered important for professional correspondence.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦メール→メール：04435_meeru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{件名|けんめい} (email subject line)
- {件名|けんめい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入力|にゅうりょく}する→入力する：28127_nyuuryokusuru⟧ (enter the subject line)
- {件名|けんめい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{変更|へんこう}する→変更する：30779_henkousuru⟧ (change the subject line)
- {件名|けんめい}⟦{欄|らん}→欄：03901_ran⟧ (subject field)
